capacity.scope: Fixture identity and task; actual HTTP and PostgreSQL. No inference or OIDC throughput claim.
capacity.latency_scope: p95 includes successful requests only. Failed requests and quota rejections remain in error rates. Status 0 includes transport failures and responses the harness could not decode.
capacity.interference: Other local development, browser and model work overlapped the soak on an 8 GB Mac. PostgreSQL and Keycloak restarted. This is an observed mixed-workload local run, not isolated hardware capacity.

outage.cause: Not established; logs prove a service restart, not its cause.

capacity.quota_correction: Original benchmark summary called all 429 responses expected. No quota rejection was planned at ten clients. Treat these as unplanned service failures; retain original raw measurements.
capacity.bounded_optimization: One pass replaced per-request connections with a maximum-eight-connection PostgreSQL pool. All four 180-second loads passed; 30-minute soak failed. No second optimization or selective clean rerun erases it.

quiet_repeat.scope: Fixture identity and task; actual HTTP and PostgreSQL. No inference or OIDC throughput claim.
quiet_repeat.host_policy: Kairos inference, website, browser checks and builds stopped. The observed separate-project build finished before measurement; other shared-host activity was not exhaustively measured.
quiet_repeat.limits: One quiet local repeat with fixture identity/tasks; not inference, OIDC throughput, production scale or resilience to arbitrary service shutdown.
